ch.title: 更新说明
content: 提升部分 Android 设备的更新下载可靠性，改用应用私有目录直连下载，并显示具体失败原因。
“我的 > 关于”新增“检查新版本”，可随时手动检查。
点击“稍后”后也能通过手动按钮再次检查更新，自动提醒仍按 24 小时去重。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Improves update-download reliability on affected Android devices by downloading directly into private app storage, with specific error details.
Adds Check for updates under Me > About for an on-demand check at any time.
Manual checks work even after choosing Later; automatic reminders remain deduplicated for 24 hours.
